set.body:
Work key: EP0
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Immediate target: docs/local-demo-plan.md
Accountable role: Product/backend/frontend engineers with local operator
Program scope: required

Scope: Run a reliable, repeatable repository demonstration on the product owner’s computer, with guides and evidence suitable for seeking institutional interest.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A packaged local installation has protected configuration, distinct runtime/migration roles, predictable start/stop/restart and a guarded demo-only reset.
2. A seeded two-lab/guest browser journey demonstrates real discovery, intake, correction, exact history/retrieval, sharing, revocation and project review work.
3. A repeatable failure/restart rehearsal and an artifact-matched quickstart/presenter/researcher guide support an honest institutional discussion; local evidence does not imply institutional approval.

References:
- docs/local-demo-plan.md

Blocked by:
- L01: bd-01M4X5M9Y1A8NCC8SRECRA62AE

Completion rule: satisfy every criterion with observed, source-bound evidence. Local fixtures and engineering checks cannot replace institutional approval, real-provider qualification, human accessibility or operator acceptance. No external outreach is authorized by this task.
set.title: EP0: Reliable local installation and guided repository demonstration
